This notebook will also produce some general overview plots for all the
DESeq2 test results.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(patchwork)
    library(ComplexHeatmap)
})

theme_md_classic <- function() {
    theme_classic(
        base_size = 10, 
        base_family = "Helvetica",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        axis.text  = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}
```

```{r}
for (nm in names(dsres)) {
    p1 <- dsres[[nm]] %>% 
        .[order(.$pvalue, decreasing=TRUE), ] %>% 
        ggplot(aes(log10(baseMean), log2FoldChange, color = -log10(padj))) + 
        geom_point() + 
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25) + 
        scale_color_viridis_c() + 
        labs(title = nm) +
        theme_md_classic()
    
    p2 <- dsres[[nm]] %>% 
        .[order(.$pvalue, decreasing=TRUE), ] %>% 
        ggplot(aes(log10(baseMean), log2FoldChange_shr, color = -log10(padj))) + 
        geom_point() + 
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25) + 
        scale_color_viridis_c() + 
        labs(title = nm) +
        theme_md_classic()
    
    ggsave(
        file.path(dir_plt, paste0(nm, ".png")),
        p1 + p2,
        width=12, height=6
    )
}
```

# All pairwise co-enrichments

Note this no longer specific to GABA vs. Glut.

I hate p-values, let's do something more comparative.

```{r}
# ----- All-pairs co-enrichment (upper tail only) -----
# dsres: named list of data.frames with rownames = peak ids
#        and columns including "log2FoldChange_shr" (or "log2FoldChange")
# q:     upper-tail quantile threshold (e.g., 0.95 or 0.99)
# use_shr: TRUE = use shrunken LFCs; FALSE = raw LFCs
#
# enrichment = observed_both / expected_both (under independence)
# pairs_upper: all pairwise combos ranked by enrichment (ties broken by n_both)
pairwise_coenrichment_upper <- function(dsres, q = 0.95, use_shr = TRUE) {
    nm <- names(dsres)
    region_of <- function(s) sub("_.*", "", s)
    nt_of     <- function(s) sub(".*_", "", s)
    col_lfc   <- if (use_shr) "log2FoldChange_shr" else "log2FoldChange"
    
    pairs <- t(combn(nm, 2))
    
    one_pair <- function(a, b) {
        da <- dsres[[a]]
        db <- dsres[[b]]
        common <- intersect(rownames(da), rownames(db))
        if (!length(common)) return(NULL)
        
        xa <- da[common, col_lfc]
        xb <- db[common, col_lfc]
        ok <- is.finite(xa) & is.finite(xb)
        xa <- xa[ok]; xb <- xb[ok]
        if (!length(xa)) return(NULL)
        
        ta <- quantile(xa, q, na.rm = TRUE)
        tb <- quantile(xb, q, na.rm = TRUE)
        ha <- xa > ta
        hb <- xb > tb
        
        n11 <- sum(ha & hb)
        pa  <- mean(ha); pb <- mean(hb)
        n   <- length(ha)
        exp_both <- n * pa * pb
        enrich   <- if (exp_both > 0) n11 / exp_both else NA_real_
        
        data.frame(
            A = a, B = b,
            region_A = region_of(a), nt_A = nt_of(a),
            region_B = region_of(b), nt_B = nt_of(b),
            same_region = region_of(a) == region_of(b),
            same_nt     = nt_of(a)     == nt_of(b),
            n = n, pA = pa, pB = pb,
            n_both = n11, expected_both = exp_both,
            enrichment = enrich,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    }
    
    out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) one_pair(pairs[i,1], pairs[i,2])))
    if (is.null(out) || !nrow(out)) 
        stop("No valid overlaps across pairs.")
    key <- out$enrichment; key[is.na(key)] <- -Inf
    o   <- order(key, out$n_both, decreasing = TRUE)
    out <- out[o, , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(out) <- NULL
    out$rank_overall <- seq_len(nrow(out))
    out
}
```

```{r}
# Upper-tail 99th percentile, using shrunken LFCs
# all_pairs_coenr <- pairwise_coenrichment_upper(dsres, q = 0.99, use_shr = TRUE) # exp=3.44, so maybe increase...
all_pairs_coenr <- pairwise_coenrichment_upper(dsres, q = 0.98, use_shr = TRUE)
```

## Heatmap enrichments

```{r}
enr_mat <- matrix(
    NA, nrow=length(dsres), ncol=length(dsres),
    dimnames = list(names(dsres), names(dsres))
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(all_pairs_coenr))) {
    rw <- all_pairs_coenr$A[i]
    cl <- all_pairs_coenr$B[i]
    enr_mat[rw, cl] <- all_pairs_coenr$enrichment[i]
    enr_mat[cl, rw] <- all_pairs_coenr$enrichment[i]
}
```

```{r}
Heatmap(
    enr_mat, 
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "peak coenrichment\n(98th percentiles)\nobs/exp"),
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0,15,30), c("#38598C", "white", "#B40426"))
)
```

```{r}
pdf(file.path(pdir, "heatmap_coenr_q98_of_lfcshr.pdf"), width=9)
Heatmap(
    enr_mat, 
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "peak coenrichment\n(98th percentiles)\nobs/exp"),
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, 30, length.out=100), viridis::viridis(100))
)
invisible(dev.off())
```

log-enrichment:

```{r}
fix_inf <- function(x) {
    idx <- which(!is.finite(x), arr.ind = TRUE)
    x[idx] <- NA
    x
}
```

```{r}
range(log2(enr_mat) %>% .[!is.infinite(.)], na.rm=T)
```


```{r}
pdf(file.path(pdir, "heatmap_coenr_q99_of_lfcshr_log2.pdf"), width=9)
Heatmap(
    log2(enr_mat) %>% fix_inf, 
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "peak coenrichment\n(99th percentiles)\nlog2(obs/exp)"),
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(-6, 6, length.out=100), viridis::viridis(100))
)
invisible(dev.off())

pdf(file.path(pdir, "heatmap_coenr_q99_of_lfcshr_log2_alt.pdf"), width=9)
Heatmap(
    log2(enr_mat) %>% fix_inf, 
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "peak coenrichment\n(99th percentiles)\nlog2(obs/exp)"),
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-6, 0, 6), c("blue", "white", "red"))
)
invisible(dev.off())
```

### Only GABA & Glut?

```{r}
idx <- grep("_(GABA|Glut)$", rownames(enr_mat))
enr_mat_gagl <- enr_mat[idx, idx]
```
